title: Old Fashioned Polish Tomato Pasta
description: A garlicky and snappy Polish dish featuring tomatoes, made with shio-cure for added depth of flavor, and is nut-free friendly. This nostalgic recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shio-cure to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until dissolved.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the tomato sauce for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the tomato sauce.
Toss the pasta in the tomato sauce to combine, then season with salt and black pepper.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
